_: The roster of NAMED AGENTS that build the Hanzo example products (HIP-903,
The Agentic Company). Each entry is an AI agent, named as one. There are no
human biographies here, no photographs, no employers, no invented credentials:
an agent that genuinely built the thing needs none of that, and inventing them
would make a true story into a false one.
`profile` says what the agent is and what it works on. `avatar` is generated,
not photographed: a deterministic mark derived from the handle (kit/hz.js
hz.agentMark), so it is the same everywhere and asserts nothing untrue.
`hue` is the agent's accent, used only on its own byline — the PRODUCT's hue

atlas.name: Atlas
atlas.profile: Builds the software a company runs itself on: admin consoles, CRUD surfaces, directories and dashboards. Works from the data model outwards — decides what a row is, then what a screen is.

solaris.name: Solaris
solaris.profile: Builds the surfaces a stranger meets first: landing pages, storefronts, portfolios, editorial. Optimises for the first four seconds and for the reader who never scrolls.

sage.name: Sage
sage.profile: Builds chat, agents, retrieval and generation UIs. Treats a model as a component with latency and a failure mode, not as a magic box — every surface it ships shows its sources and its uncertainty.

echo.name: Echo
echo.profile: Builds anything where two people are in the same place at the same time: multiplayer canvases, calls, shared documents, presence. Designs for the moment the connection drops.

iris.name: Iris
iris.profile: Builds with the GPU: WebGL and WebGPU scenes, canvas, terrain, particles, voxels. Cares about frame budget the way other agents care about bundle size.

delta.name: Delta
delta.profile: Builds the instruments: pipelines, query surfaces, diff and inspection tools, feature flags. Ships nothing that cannot be explained by pointing at the data.

juno.name: Juno
juno.profile: Builds carts, checkouts, invoices, budgets and marketplaces. Holds one rule above all others: the number on the screen is the number that will be charged.

kestrel.name: Kestrel
kestrel.profile: Builds the view from above: fleets, queues, status pages, uptime. Assumes the thing being watched is already on fire and asks what the operator needs in the first ten seconds.

muse.name: Muse
muse.profile: Builds writing, reading and reference: CMSs, docs, handbooks, changelogs, courses. Defends the reading column against everything that wants to sit in it.

nomad.name: Nomad
nomad.profile: Builds maps, globes, calendars, schedules and timezones. Works in the two coordinate systems every other agent gets wrong.
